Name: Root-of-Trust Unit Design and Interface with RISC-V Host Processor (TitanCFI)
Description: Silicon Root-of-Trust / secure element derived from OpenTitan Earl Grey: RV32 (CV32E) core, crypto accelerators (AES, SHA-256, SHA-3, HMAC, KMAC, OTBN, TRNG), key management and OTP secure storage. Loosely coupled to the RISC-V host via an AXI4 initiator port and an SCMI mailbox for host control; supports secure boot. Implemented in GF12LP+ (0.63 mm2, 300 MHz) and on VCU118.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 3.1.10; IP cards on GitHub (pulp-unibo/isolde_ip_cards).
